ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Gies College of Business majors and Actuarial Science. Seats will be opened to Agricultural Accounting, Finance in Agribusiness, Agricultural Finance, Consumer Economics and Finance majors, STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship, and Technology and Management minors two weeks after priority registration.
